text:
elaine: quick sync — need to lock the enterprise compliance roadmap slices for H1. main asks: audit log retention tiers, BYOK/KMS priority, SOC2 artifacts, and export/search SLAs. who can own final decision?

sam: I can own runtime constraints. big thing: long retention + searchable = storage + indexing costs. we should split "hot" vs "cold" retention buckets.

nisha: +1 on buckets. security POV: BYOK handshake + escrow options are high risk. recommend BYOK pilot (customer-managed keys) before full GA. SOC2 items we can bundle with BYOK pilot to show control maturity.

william: from sales: 2 strategic customers asked for 7yr immutable audit retention and BYOK. they'd pay premium. timeline matters — they want pilot in 8-10 weeks.

maria: infra note: indexing 7 years of audit events for search is expensive. proposal: default retention 90d searchable, 7yr cold archive (exportable). add an export API for legal requests.

elaine: proposal draft: MVP = BYOK handshake (key onboarding + rotation docs), audit export API, retention tiers: 90d hot, 2yr warm (fast restore), 7yr cold (on-demand). Search SLA only guaranteed on hot.

sam: technical limits: hot = immediate search, warm = nearline (<=2h restore), cold = export-only (SLA none). we can provide a sample restore flow:
```
GET /audit/export?tenant=acme&start=...&end=...
200 -> signed url to gz archive in customer region
```

nisha: compliance acceptance criteria for MVP: BYOK onboarding flow tested with one customer, SOC2 evidence bundle exported for a 30-day window, immutable write guarantees for hot tier.

william: ok to price pilot. need product doc for sales (one-pager + checklist). I'll take coordinator.

maria: ops cost estimate: incremental storage + indexing = ~20% run cost for pilot with 2 customers. cold exports add egress ops. need approval from finance for pilot budget.

elaine: action items:
- sam: final tech design + perf numbers by Tue (owner)
- nisha: SOC2 evidence checklist and BYOK test plan by Wed
- william: sales one-pager + pilot cohort list by Wed EOD
- maria: ops cost model + export runbook by Thu
- elaine: consolidate into launch criteria doc and schedule a decision block Friday

devops-bot: reminder: #deploys scheduled Thu 02:00 UTC — do not merge breaking infra changes during pilot prep window :robot_face:


sam: noted. small follow-up: can we allow customer opt-in for making warm searchable (extra cost)? that would solve sales asks without full-time indexing.

nisha: yes, opt-in searchable warm tier sounds good. must include clear legal/SLAs in contract.

elaine: consensus seems to be: phased MVP with clear buckets, BYOK pilot, search guaranteed on hot, opt-in for warm search. i'll draft the acceptance criteria doc and share for review. Thanks all :raised_hands:
